One true model drives readout, motion, caption and print

nodes.label: Camera Contract
nodes.rationale: World space so effects agree with the drawing's projection.

nodes.label: Anything That Wraps A Pipe Splits It
nodes.norm_label: anything that wraps a pipe splits it
nodes.rationale: A pipe running through a collar as one chunk is both behind and in front of it; no key can order it.

nodes.label: Stress Scene
nodes.rationale: Performance and layer-proof scene, not audit-clean; copy patterns from build.mjs.

nodes.label: Azimuth Identity
nodes.rationale: Turning by theta about a vertical axis equals the kit drawing at azimuth a - theta because the light is camera-locked, so kit builders at P'(theta) are the fidelity reference.

nodes.label: Convex Parts Only
nodes.rationale: Separating planes require convex solids; concave bodies become convex pieces.

nodes.label: Rest Pose World Coordinates
nodes.rationale: Constructors take world coordinates at rest so recorder, kit and engine share one world.

nodes.label: Separating-Plane Painter's Order
nodes.rationale: Two disjoint convex solids whose projections overlap are hit by a view ray crossed once by a separating plane; flicker-free since relation flips only edge-on.

nodes.label: Slip Ring Cable Rule
nodes.rationale: No route ever spans static ground and a turning group.

nodes.label: Tubes Never Point Along The View
nodes.norm_label: tubes never point along the view

nodes.label: Turning Groups
nodes.rationale: Only when the motion is the explanation (dial read as it turns, turntable, hand that grips); never as decoration. Status beta.

nodes.label: Requirements
nodes.rationale: Node 20.10+ built-ins only, Chrome/Chromium for checks, React 18+ for React output

nodes.label: Supported agents
nodes.rationale: Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex and MiniMax Code via the open Agent Skills format

nodes.label: SVG + WebGL figure kind
nodes.rationale: For what lines cannot draw: fire, exhaust, water, caustics; shader sits in the figure's isometric camera between back and front SVG

nodes.label: Anatomy skill
nodes.rationale: An Agent Skill that explains a technical idea by building it as a real working physical object

nodes.label: Limits
nodes.rationale: Not a chart library; draws machines not people; slow on purpose; shaders need WebGL

nodes.label: Three prompting habits
nodes.rationale: Name the idea not the drawing, or name the object, and say where it will live

nodes.label: Layer Stack
nodes.rationale: A shader can't be depth-tested against SVG, so layers are ordered instead.

nodes.label: WebGL Inside The Drawing Guide
nodes.rationale: Bar: nothing pops, nothing is cut, everything sits in the drawing's perspective.

nodes.label: When A Shader Earns Its Place
nodes.norm_label: when a shader earns its place
nodes.rationale: For continuous fields lines can't draw; never solids or decoration; SVG must read on its own.

nodes.label: rig.ts pure model
nodes.rationale: Behaviour copied into one pure model so readout, aria, caption and moving parts all read from it

nodes.label: Test rig painter's order
nodes.rationale: Frame and springs are split so the carriage sits inside them

nodes.label: Painter's order
nodes.rationale: Paint back to front, bottom to top; once a figure has pipes, true depth is measured by A.settle instead of tuning keys by eye

nodes.label: Parts list
nodes.rationale: At least 40 parts grouped by base, structure, mechanism, controls, subject

nodes.label: Workflow
nodes.rationale: Concept and parts list before geometry, because most quality is decided there

nodes.label: Truth first
nodes.rationale: Readout, motion and caption must all come from one pure model of real numbers

nodes.label: Stagger order
nodes.rationale: Ordered so nothing passes through: whoever is outside leaves first; Raptor went from 66 mid-flight collisions to zero

nodes.label: Tone hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Exactly one lit accent marks the part the reader should watch

nodes.label: Verify like a critic
nodes.rationale: The owner finds faults by zooming in, so zoom in first and read every PNG

nodes.label: A texture ends on a real edge or fades
nodes.norm_label: a texture ends on a real edge or fades

nodes.label: Every crossing in true depth order
nodes.norm_label: every crossing in true depth order
nodes.rationale: Proved by A.settle and the audit, never tuned by eye; an interlock is fixed with a cut, never a bias

nodes.label: No pipe or cable passes through anything
nodes.norm_label: no pipe or cable passes through anything

nodes.label: Envelopes for one-shot events
nodes.rationale: Setting a value to 1 in one frame is a pop

nodes.label: WebGL inside the drawing
nodes.rationale: Learned from the first shader figure whose phase colour change looked cut rather than crossfaded

nodes.label: The object is the explanation
nodes.rationale: Ask for an idea, Anatomy invents a physical thing whose working is the concept, e.g. a cache key becomes a pin-tumbler lock

nodes.label: Every creation is highly detailed
nodes.rationale: At 1x one clear machine, at 4x every region still has something true to find; detail must be purposeful

nodes.label: Light theme shaders designed for paper
nodes.norm_label: light theme shaders designed for paper
nodes.rationale: Normal premultiplied alpha, never screen; a darkened dark-theme glow gave the Raptor's red ink smoke

nodes.label: Shaders never pop
nodes.rationale: Every uniform rides an envelope with attack and decay; phase changes are crossfades

nodes.label: The one idea that matters
nodes.rationale: The object is the explanation: invent a real physical thing whose working is the concept; boxes and arrows fail as too abstract or too flat

nodes.label: Hinge Chains
nodes.rationale: Keep ranges physical and small; a route on a hinged link carries the link's pitch range.

nodes.label: Knuckle Disc
nodes.rationale: A disc coaxial with its hinge is invariant under the hinge so never collides and provides the contact the rigid audit needs.

nodes.label: Tube Bend Radius Bound
nodes.rationale: R >= 2r / sin^2(e - theta_max); past ~15 degrees no practical radius holds, so turn inside a fitting.

nodes.label: Contacts And Junctions
nodes.rationale: Nothing is sunk into anything: a sunk part is both in front of and behind its host.

nodes.label: Themes And Tokens
nodes.rationale: Light ships; every colour is a token.

nodes.label: Tone Assignment
nodes.rationale: Base lo, structure mid, subject hi, exactly one lit accent.

nodes.label: Crafted Figure Qualities
nodes.rationale: Approved figures: a real buildable object, many small precise parts, volume, calm, truth.

nodes.label: Fixing One Close-Up By Eye
nodes.rationale: Hand-set keys looked right at 1x and had 323 depth-order problems.

nodes.label: Painter's Order
nodes.rationale: Base first, sort by depthOf ascending, split wrapping parts; dense figures settle keys from geometry.

nodes.label: Post Collar Clamp And Thumb Screw
nodes.norm_label: post collar clamp and thumb screw

nodes.label: Seams Welds And Trim Lines On A Box
nodes.norm_label: seams welds and trim lines on a box

nodes.label: Keyboard and accessibility
nodes.rationale: Write aria value text only on choice changes, not per frame, to avoid streams of announcements

nodes.label: One loop per figure
nodes.rationale: Write the DOM through refs; never re-render React per frame

nodes.label: Stop when settled or offscreen
nodes.rationale: Read the newest IntersectionObserver entry; reading the first left figures frozen

nodes.label: Time-based motion
nodes.rationale: Clamp dt to 1/30 s so a background tab doesn't jump

nodes.label: inkFor
nodes.rationale: Inverts normal compositing over white so the paper shows exactly the designed colour.

nodes.label: Ink Stops At Stroke Inner Edge
nodes.norm_label: ink stops at stroke inner edge

nodes.label: Light Theme
nodes.rationale: Light is the shipping theme; seven dark-plate conversions each took three review rounds.

nodes.label: Blackbody Ordered Ramp
nodes.rationale: Hot bodies run dull red, orange, yellow, near-white; red mixed toward white is salmon and no temperature looks like that.

nodes.label: Red Ink Smoke
nodes.rationale: Raptor light plume multiplies hue by fixed dark red and sets alpha to brightness; don't copy it.

nodes.label: sheet.mjs spec
nodes.rationale: Every number and sentence must come from the figure's model or caption, the same truth rule as the figure

nodes.label: Both themes work, and light ships
nodes.norm_label: both themes work, and light ships

nodes.label: Kit changes are opt-in
nodes.rationale: Every existing example must rebuild byte-identical; CI checks it

nodes.label: No comments in code
nodes.rationale: Explanation belongs in names and structure

nodes.label: Monotone Cubic Hermite (Fritsch-Carlson)
nodes.rationale: A natural spline overshoots near a peak; a monotone curve can only turn where the profile turns. It is only C1, so large bodies need analytic r(s) with slope.

nodes.label: Smooth Shading Option
nodes.rationale: Without it every facet row gets one flat tone and curved profiles show a staircase.

nodes.label: Line Ends Check
nodes.rationale: The audit sees recorded shapes, never line markup, so a separate drawing check is needed.

nodes.label: Lines That Stop In Mid-Air
nodes.rationale: Every line must land on something.

nodes.label: Textures End On An Edge Or Fade
nodes.norm_label: textures end on an edge or fade

nodes.label: Textures That Stop
nodes.rationale: Owner: fade them out rather than an instant stop.

nodes.label: Audit Report Lines
nodes.rationale: A zero audit is necessary, not sufficient.

nodes.label: Close-Ups
nodes.rationale: The owner found Raptor faults on a light-theme close-up; shoot it yourself first.

nodes.label: Slow Mode
nodes.rationale: Slow mode does not slow setTimeout timers; stub idle-tour timers before slowed sheets.

nodes.label: Verify Guide
nodes.rationale: Look at the figure as a demanding reviewer would before anyone else does; rendering is cheap, guessing expensive.

nodes.label: Size it before you start
nodes.rationale: Figure / Hero / Epic tiers; Epic not started until user chooses it over a proposed Hero

nodes.label: No time quoted for a Figure
nodes.norm_label: no time quoted for a figure
nodes.rationale: The 30-90 minute estimate was often far longer than the build itself (issue #41)

nodes.label: Mozilla code of conduct enforcement ladder
nodes.norm_label: mozilla code of conduct enforcement ladder

nodes.label: Orbit Audit
nodes.rationale: Slow; iterate with --quick --only, final full run in background; only full run's 'turn audit passed' counts.

nodes.label: Exact Coordinates For Continuity
nodes.rationale: Rounded paths left a floor on long edges that read as jumps, so orbit switches to TURN.exact for the continuity line.

nodes.label: Planted Faults
nodes.rationale: Every audit line has a planted fault that fails it, proving the check works.

nodes.label: Nothing Pops
nodes.rationale: First ignition flash went 0 to full in one frame and whited out the card.

nodes.label: graph.json full rewrite on build
nodes.rationale: graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so a large PR diff is expected and should not be flagged as churn

nodes.label: Gallery rejection rules
nodes.rationale: Gallery builds in a locked sandbox: no network, eval, env reads, or nondeterministic builds

nodes.label: Security scope
nodes.rationale: Chrome-launching scripts run headless with file access and drive.mjs executes passed JS, so only point them at trusted pages

nodes.label: Publishing to the community gallery
nodes.rationale: Publish only when the user asks; never send anything without explicit yes

nodes.label: Anti-Patterns
nodes.rationale: Each was rejected by a reviewer.

nodes.label: Colour Everywhere
nodes.rationale: Monochrome unless colour is the subject; one lit accent.

nodes.label: Dark-Theme Glows Pasted On White
nodes.rationale: Darkened glows gave 'red ink smoke'.

nodes.label: Stand-In Shapes
nodes.rationale: Stand-ins silenced the audit while the rod outline was notched.

nodes.label: Saddle Pad
nodes.rationale: A flat flange on a curved body leaves a sagitta gap; seat it on a pad belonging to the host's assembly.

nodes.label: Pipes Through Pipes
nodes.rationale: Owner zoomed in on first Raptor and saw cables passing through ducts.

nodes.label: Live readout
nodes.rationale: Phase word and number must come from the same instant of the same source

nodes.label: Large-page key-warning trap
nodes.rationale: Streamed lazy element props lack keys; fix with stable keys and keeping use-client components out of server art

nodes.label: Server/client split
nodes.rationale: Geometry runs on the server so the client receives finished path strings; only live component ships as client code
